extras.real_size: two-horse trailer, 4.6 m long incl. drawbar, 2.2 m wide over the fenders, 2.6 m high, tandem axle, wheels 0.62 m diameter
extras.notes: tall boxy horse box in tractor green with a cream rubbing strip, a dark wrap-around window band with small barred sliding windows, a rounded low front nose with a window, light roof with two roof hatches; rear with wide ramp, two split upper rear doors and aluminium corner posts; narrow front escape door; inside rubber floor, centre partition, breast bar and two hay nets; A-frame drawbar with coupling, front locker and fixed jockey wheel; the rear ramp 'horse-trailer_ramp' is separate with its origin on the lower hinge edge (rotate around local X to lower it); 4 wheels '_wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr' with origin in the hub (front/rear axle, left/right); drawbar faces -Y; preview orbit from the rear right recommended; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
